text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've come to watch the Arima Kinen, where Mejiro Palmer sees Oguri Cap overcome tremendous pressure to achieve a dramatic victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Oguri Cap tells Mejiro Palmer that she turns pressure into power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer declares that she'll get strong enough to never worry about pressure.
